canonical_claim: Edouard Benedictus recounted that a dropped laboratory flask cracked while its fragments stayed attached to a cellulose-nitrate film, inspiring his development of Triplex laminated safety glass.
subject: laminated safety glass
object_or_result: broken flask fragments held together by a cellulose-nitrate film
surface_text: Laminated safety glass was inspired by a flask whose broken pieces stayed together

sources.title: Conserving Plastics in Early Aircraft Cockpits
sources.supports: Describes Benedictus's account of a dropped flask whose cracked glass remained attached to a cellulose-nitrate film and the resulting development of Triplex safety glass.

canonical_claim: George de Mestral developed Velcro's hook-and-loop fastening design after examining tiny hooks on burrs that clung to clothing and dog fur.
subject: Velcro fastener
object_or_result: burr hooks clinging to fabric and fur
surface_text: Velcro's hook-and-loop design copied tiny burr hooks that clung to fabric and fur
